The vendor directly providing **Redis** at **redis.io** is **Redis Ltd.** (operating in the United States and the Americas through its subsidiary, **Redis Inc.**).

### Evidence:
* **Privacy Policy (`redis.io/legal/privacy`):** 
  > *"Redis Ltd. and/or their applicable affiliates (“Redis”, “us”, or “we”) are committed to protecting your privacy... such as when you: (i) visit www.redis.io... and (ii) trial, purchase download and/or subscribe to our cloud services or software (the “Services” or “Software”, respectively)."*
* **Licenses (`redis.io/legal/licenses`):**
  > *"Redis Ltd. is the company that stands behind Redis. Our main mission as a company is focused on furthering Redis for the benefit of the Redis community."*
* **Software Agreement (`redis.io/legal/software-agreement`):** Identifies contracting entities as **Redis Inc.** (a Delaware corporation located at 303 2nd St., North Tower, Suite 525, San Francisco, CA) for customers domiciled in the Americas, Asia, and Pacific, and parent company **Redis Ltd.** (located in Tel-Aviv, Israel).
